Definition: from G1909 and G1416; to set fully (as the sun):--go down.
BiblicalUsage: Epidyo means to go down, of the sun — and Paul uses it once, in the command not to let the sun go down upon your wrath. The day has an end, and anger is not to outlast it.
TheologicalSignificance: The sunset is God's deadline for anger, I believe: settle it before the day ends, or it will settle in you.
